description: Gruntas: the mod (usage.ts) sends the account's usage windows through `gruntas hook claude usage`; each event runs `gruntas hook claude <event>`, which tells the gruntas daemon about the session (a permission prompt shows it waiting on you) and never rewrites a tool call or answers a prompt; it refuses only what the paste guards refuse, and Stop reminds the agent to report its status (gruntas_report) after work it has not reported. Without gruntas on the PATH the hooks do nothing, SessionStart says how to install it, and WorktreeCreate fails with that line, since Claude Code's worktrees then come from gruntas.

hooks.command: command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{"systemMessage":"gruntas is not on the PATH, so this session is not registered with it. Install it: curl -fsSL https://gruntas.com/install | bash"}'; exit 0; }; exec gruntas hook claude SessionStart
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude SessionEnd
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude PreToolUse
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude PostToolUse
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude PostToolUseFailure
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude PermissionRequest
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude PermissionDenied
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude Stop

command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'WorktreeCreate: gruntas is not on the PATH. Install it: curl -fsSL https://gruntas.com/install | bash' >&2; exit 1; }; exec gruntas hook claude WorktreeCreate
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook claude WorktreeRemove
